meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). In Codex, honor explicit requests for the Codex Chrome plugin/@chrome by using the Chrome Extension workflow; otherwise use Chrome Computer Use when available and fall back to real Chrome CDP scripts only when allowed. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或即时将文章推送到 X 账号。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or instantly push articles to your X account.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把文字、图片、视频或长文章发布到 X（Twitter）。它会自动打开 Chrome 浏览器，填好内容，等你确认后再发布。
howto.when: 当你要求“发推”、“发布到 X”、“分享到 Twitter”或“发布文章”时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这段话发到 X：今天天气真好！
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器，填好文字，等你确认后发布。

say.text: 把这张图片和文字一起发推。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器，附上图片，等你确认后发布。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can post text, images, videos, or long-form articles to X (Twitter). It opens Chrome, fills in the content, and waits for your confirmation before publishing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", "share on X", or request to publish an article.

say_en.text: Post this to X: The weather is great today!
say_en.note: Claude opens Chrome, fills in the text, and waits for your confirmation.

say_en.text: Tweet this image with the caption above.
say_en.note: Claude opens Chrome, attaches the image, and waits for your confirmation.
